anomalies.description: A white sedan collides with a dark-colored SUV in the intersection; the impact ejects a dark object (likely a tire or part) into the air, and both vehicles spin out of control.

A silver sedan loses control on the snowy road, slides sideways across the shoulder, and impacts the snowbank on the right side, kicking up a large plume of snow.; The silver sedan remains stationary in the snowbank after the crash, angled diagonally with its front end embedded in the snow; no further movement or secondary impact is observed during this period.

A vehicle (likely a car carrier truck) is seen with its rear lights illuminated and appears to be stationary or severely slowed on the roadside after an incident; a white car is visible on the carrier's platform, suggesting a prior crash or breakdown.

A high-speed collision occurs: the vehicle from which the footage is recorded impacts another vehicle or object, resulting in a violent forward lurch, bright flash of light, and massive debris/dust cloud obscuring the view.; Post-collision aftermath: the camera vehicle is stationary or moving very slowly with severely impaired visibility due to shattered windshield (visible from f9–f12) and debris; final frames show the vehicle stopped near trees/vegetation (f14–f15), indicating the crash has concluded and the vehicle is off the road.
Vehicle loses control on icy road, slides sideways, and impacts roadside vegetation or embankment; windshield becomes heavily obscured by snow/debris during and after impact.

A white van on the left side of the road loses control on icy/snowy surface, swerves sharply right across the lane, and collides with or near the central guardrail, kicking up a large plume of snow/dust. The van is visibly airborne or heavily tilted during impact (frames f2–f5).

A second vehicle (dark-colored, possibly a truck or SUV) further ahead on the same road loses traction, slides sideways, and impacts the left-side barrier, generating a large cloud of snow/dust. The vehicle appears to spin or jackknife before coming to rest (frames f8–f11).
